one_line: Play The Secret of Monkey Island through ChatGPT and WebMCP.
what_it_does: Runs the DOS game in browser WebAssembly and exposes semantic observation and control tools for an agent to play alongside a human.
leverage_rationale: Semantic room, inventory, navigation, verb, dialogue, and save-state tools make agent play markedly more reliable than pixel/UI driving, while preserving shared live game state.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: seven tools expose room, characters, objects, inventory, movement, verbs, dialogue, new game, waiting, and saves
PITCH: agent can ask for help, talk through the game, or play it
execution_rationale: The architecture and scope are unusually well described and the deployed demo is alive, but no transcript or submitted video evidence demonstrates a complete playthrough.
execution_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: ScummVM compiled to WebAssembly with C++ bridge and TypeScript controller for async actions, errors, cancellation, and traces
impact_rationale: Strong value for adventure-game players and a compelling demonstration of agents operating a traditionally non-agentic game, though the audience is specialized.
impact_evidence: PITCH: play a classic adventure game through ChatGPT and WebMCP
ABOUT TEXT: human can ask for help or let the agent attempt the game
creativity_rationale: Applying structured WebMCP semantics to a 35-year-old SCUMM game running in WebAssembly is a memorable, technically ambitious interaction model.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: asks whether WebMCP can describe a 35-year-old game running inside WebAssembly
ABOUT TEXT: semantic information exposed from the SCUMM engine
usability_note: The game concept is familiar, but supplying game files and relying on an agent may add setup friction.
red_flags: No submitted video or transcript; end-to-end agent play is claimed rather than demonstrated.
standouts: Semantic agent control of a classic game engine rather than generic screenshot clicking.
advance_reason: Distinctive, technically deep WebMCP leverage and high creativity; execution evidence is thinner than the concept.

one_line: A shared theater stage where humans and agents build and perform screenplays.
what_it_does: Lets people and agents place characters and props, write acts and dialogue, control camera and motion, and perform animated scenes.
leverage_rationale: The agent is a co-creator and performer with structured access to scene objects, motion, camera, scripts, and parallel actions; this is more than UI automation.

ABOUT TEXT: agent can write scripts, set up acts, create dialogue, perform in parallel, and respond to the human

impact_rationale: It offers a concrete collaborative medium for playful storytelling and lowers the barrier to making animated performances, with credible value for creators and audiences.
impact_evidence: PITCH: humans and agents build, perform, and share screenplays
ABOUT TEXT: human creative touch paired with agent speed and accuracy
creativity_rationale: A live agent-human theater with controllable staging, custom gibberish speech, camera direction, and performance is a fresh and memorable synthesis.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: collage tool evolved into a full theater stage with cast, sound effects, dialogues, hand-crafted motion, and performance
ABOUT TEXT: agent can watch the human and adjust or narrate
usability_note: The playful staged metaphor is approachable, though the breadth of controls may create learning overhead.
red_flags: No submitted video or transcript; full performance loop is not directly evidenced.
standouts: Agent is treated as director/performer, not merely an assistant.
advance_reason: High creativity, clear agent-centered interaction, and credible creator value.

one_line: Audit whether a site is ready for agents and generate a working WebMCP tool from it.
what_it_does: Audits public URLs across six checks, reports findings, and emits copy-paste tool registration code based on a page's form metadata.
leverage_rationale: The audit itself is a structured agent-callable capability and its output recruits more WebMCP surfaces by generating schemas and registration code; general UI driving would be less repeatable and precise.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: declared audit_site tool returns score, grade, coverage, and top finding
ABOUT TEXT: generates toolname, descriptions, JSON schema, and registerTool code from the audited page
execution_rationale: The stated audit flow and remediation output are coherent and the deployed demo is alive, but no video or transcript demonstrates a full audit.
execution_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: six evidence-backed checks, prioritized remediation, and computed +N with WebMCP
impact_rationale: It targets a real and growing developer problem: making sites usable by agents, with actionable output rather than an abstract score.
impact_evidence: PITCH: helps developers find out if their site/app is agent ready
ABOUT TEXT: invisible problem becomes a number with a fix and copy-paste remediations
creativity_rationale: The recursive idea of an agent-ready auditor that produces more WebMCP for the rest of the web is a strong original angle.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: AgentReady attacks adoption twice over and creates more WebMCP for every audited page
usability_note: Fast URL-to-report framing and copy-paste remediation suggest good utility; runtime proof is absent.
red_flags: No submitted video or transcript; claims about generated code are not visually demonstrated.
standouts: Closed loop from audit to deployable WebMCP implementation.
advance_reason: Strong practical impact and unusually direct contribution to WebMCP adoption.

one_line: Refuse unsafe hazmat loads with the exact governing CFR rule, then expose export only when safe.
what_it_does: Reads chemical manifests, applies segregation and forbidden-material rules, shows cited refusals, and conditionally creates shipping-paper export tools for passing loads.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP dynamically removes unsafe actions from the live tool registry and exposes export only after state passes; this changes the safety boundary, not just convenience.
leverage_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: commit_manifest is absent from getTools() when load fails and appears only when it passes
VIDEO TRANSCRIPT: agent proposes arrangement while page refuses and quotes 177.848(e)(3); export exists only when the load passes
VIDEO TRANSCRIPT: handler re-derives verdict from bytes it was asked to write
execution_rationale: The video transcript and frame sheet show a coherent refusal workflow, exact regulatory citations, barrier handling, and conditional export; the complete accepted path is described though frame evidence emphasizes refusal.
execution_evidence: VIDEO TRANSCRIPT: sulfuric acid/calcium hypochlorite refusal, barrier clause, two-vehicle pass, shipping paper in required sequence
FRAME SHEET: visible MANIFEST, REFUSED result, hazard symbols, LOAD PLAN, and legal-responsibility explanation
impact_rationale: Hazmat shippers have a specific high-stakes compliance problem, and the product directly prevents unsafe or legally invalid paperwork while making the rule auditable.
impact_evidence: PITCH: shows exactly which line of 49 CFR each pair breaks
VIDEO TRANSCRIPT: person signing certification is personally responsible; page refuses and quotes the rule
ABOUT TEXT: 256 forbidden materials are handled as forbidden rather than missing data
creativity_rationale: The fail-closed, state-dependent tool surface is a deep and memorable use of WebMCP for regulated safety workflows.
creativity_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: same page and agent have different tools one frame apart depending on load validity
VIDEO TRANSCRIPT: agent cannot choose unsafe action because the action does not exist
usability_note: Clear manifest/refusal/pass states and exact citations support operator comprehension; high-stakes use still warrants careful human review.
standouts: WebMCP is used as a dynamic safety gate, not a button wrapper.
Exact legal text and re-derived validation strengthen trust.
advance_reason: Best packet: transformative leverage, strong observed execution, high-stakes impact, and ambitious safety design.

one_line: A marketing dashboard that gives agents scoped, receipt-backed evidence.

leverage_rationale: Structured evidence vocabulary, provenance, limits, and receipts address exactly what agents cannot reliably infer from dashboard pixels; authority is deliberately bounded.

ABOUT TEXT: tools inherit live page/session context and disappear when the user leaves

execution_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: live WebMCP explorer, verifiable invocation receipt, fail-closed security path

impact_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: reconstructing what changed, why, and what to do next is scattered across dashboards and exports
ABOUT TEXT: traces metrics to Search Console or GA4 with prior value and transparent change calculation

red_flags: No submitted video or transcript; operational behavior is claimed rather than shown.
standouts: Trust boundary is represented in every result rather than hidden in documentation.
advance_reason: Strong agent-specific evidence design and credible business value, with moderate execution evidence.

one_line: A bounded live canvas where agents redesign interfaces around a user's needs.
what_it_does: Lets agents curate storefront results, compose a dashboard, or generate bespoke data-table reports inside constrained browser-owned regions.
leverage_rationale: The bounded canvas gives agents structured compositional control while constraining unsafe arbitrary DOM changes; this enables adaptive UI patterns that ordinary UI driving cannot reproduce cleanly.
leverage_evidence: PITCH: bring your own user interface
ABOUT TEXT: agent curates results with approved card presets and badges, composes dashboards, and generates reports in a bounded Live Canvas

impact_evidence: ABOUT TEXT: shopping interface can rank matches, explain rationale, and adapt layout; dashboards can be personal and generated on demand
